rm(list=ls())

# Read in files
```{r}
megatable <- read.csv("../data/pangenome_project_megatable.csv")
consensus <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Reference", "Consensus_Precision", "Consensus_Recall", "Consensus_F1_Score")]
strelka <- megatable[c("Donor_ID", "Reference", "Strelka_Precision", "Strelka_Recall", "Strelka_F1_Score")]
```

# Setup
```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)

reference_colors <- c("#C0DEA4", "#72a643")
black_colors <- c("black", "black")
```

# Useful functions
```{r}
rename_col <- function(df) {
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Recall$", colnames(df))] <- "Recall"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_Precision$", colnames(df))] <- "Precision"
  colnames(df)[grepl("_F1_Score$", colnames(df))] <- "F1_Score"
  return(df)
}

as_numeric <- function(df) {
  df <- df[df$Reference %in% c("Pangenome", "Linear"), ]
  df$F1_Score <- as.numeric(df$F1_Score)
  df$Precision <- as.numeric(df$Precision)
  df$Recall <- as.numeric(df$Recall)
  return(df)
}

delta_diff <- function(strelka, consensus) {
  merged <- merge(
    strelka, consensus, 
    by = c("Donor_ID", "Reference"), 
    suffixes = c("_Strelka", "_Consensus")
  )
  
  result <- data.frame(
    Donor_ID        = merged$Donor_ID,
    Reference       = merged$Reference,
    Delta_Recall    = merged$Recall_Strelka - merged$Recall_Consensus,
    Delta_Precision = merged$Precision_Strelka - merged$Precision_Consensus,
    Delta_F1_Score  = merged$F1_Score_Strelka - merged$F1_Score_Consensus
  )
  
  return(result)
}
```

# Process
```{r}
consensus <- rename_col(consensus)
strelka <- rename_col(strelka)

consensus <- as_numeric(consensus)
strelka <- as_numeric(strelka)
```

# Combine
```{r}
combined <- delta_diff(strelka, consensus)

combined_long <- data.frame(
  Donor_ID = rep(combined$Donor_ID, times = 3),
  Reference = rep(combined$Reference, times = 3),
  Metric = rep(c("Delta_F1_Score", "Delta_Precision", "Delta_Recall"), 
               each = nrow(combined)),
  Value  = c(combined$Delta_F1_Score, 
             combined$Delta_Precision, 
             combined$Delta_Recall)
)
```

# Plot
```{r}
dodge <- position_dodge(width = 0.8)
jitterdodge <- position_jitterdodge(jitter.width = 0.1, dodge.width = 0.8)

set.seed(1)
boxplot_output <- ggplot(combined_long, aes(Metric, Value, fill=Reference)) + 
  annotate(
    "rect",
    xmin = -Inf, xmax = 1.5,      
    ymin = -Inf, ymax = Inf,   
    alpha = 0.2,                
    fill = "grey") +
  stat_boxplot(
    geom = "errorbar", 
    width = 0.3, 
    color = "black", 
    size = 0.6,
    position = dodge) +
  geom_hline(
    yintercept = 0, 
    linetype = "solid", 
    color = "black", 
    size = 1) +
  geom_boxplot(
    width = 0.6,
    outlier.shape = NA,
    alpha = 1,
    color = "black",
    size = 0.6,
    position = dodge) +
  labs(
    # title = plot_title, 
    x = element_blank(), 
    y = expression(paste(Delta, " Metric Percentage (%)"))) +
  scale_x_discrete(labels = c(
    "Delta_F1_Score" = "F1 Score",
    "Delta_Precision" = "Precision",
    "Delta_Recall" = "Recall"))  +
  scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(-40, 56),
    breaks = seq(-100, 100, 20)) +
  scale_fill_manual(
    values = reference_colors) +
  scale_color_manual(
    values = black_colors) +
  geom_jitter(
    size = 2,
    shape = 21,
    aes(color = Reference),
    fill = NA,
    alpha = 0.9,
    position = jitterdodge) +
  guides(
    color = guide_legend(
      override.aes = list(shape = 22,
                          size = 6,
                          fill = reference_colors, 
                          color = "black")), 
    fill  = "none") +
  theme(
    legend.position = "inside",
    legend.position.inside = c(0.88, 0.15),
    legend.background = element_rect(fill = "white", color = NA),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 18),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 18),
    panel.background = element_rect(fill = "white"),
    # panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
    # panel.grid.minor.y = element_line(color = "#F0F0F0"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5, size = 18),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.text.y = element_text(size = 18, color = "black"),
    axis.title.y = element_text(size = 20), 
    # panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, size = 0.5)
    panel.border = element_blank(),
    axis.line.x.bottom = element_line(color = "black"),
    axis.line.y.left   = element_line(color = "black")
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 0.5, y = Inf,
    label = "Strelka - Consensus",
    size = 6,
    color = "black",
    hjust = 0,
    vjust = 2
  ) +
  geom_vline(
    xintercept = c(1.5, 2.5), 
    linetype = "dashed", 
    color = "grey", 
    size = 0.6)

boxplot_output
```
